mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, directly increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline periods produce negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 4.0% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 months yields negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% in the same month indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering S&P 500 sell-offs over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >1% in same month
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in same month produces positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 2% annualized signals economic overheating and imminent monetary tightening, causing S&P 500 underperformance over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth >2% annualized yields positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth >1% annualized produces negative 60-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% yields positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS >50k) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < -0.1pp) in the same month indicate accelerating labor market tightening, preceding Fed rate hikes and causing S&P 500 underperformance over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS >50k and UNRATE < -0.1pp in same month
failure_condition: PAYEMS >50k and UNRATE < -0.1pp in same month produces positive 5-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,350,000 units during late-cycle expansion signals overvaluation and impending slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST >1,350,000 in late-cycle expansion yields positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases.
